reviews: [[VIDEOID:f4433ddee6947fd313fa4549efbec5db]] If you’ve got a ton of gear that you’re uploading from and in need of an all in one hub this it. I can upload from my Sony, my drone and body cams etc all with this hub. Definitely for someone who wants to streamline their editing process and minimize desk clutter.
It works for the skydio s2 but is a pain to put together every time I take the drone out for a flight.

I use this with Mavic Air 2 and it works well with my iPad. Gives me a much bigger viewing screen. My only gripe is I wish it were or of a clip on vs having to screw/clip it to the controller. Not a big deal to take off to fit in my case and comes with a very small Allen wrench to attach/remove it.
This is my third drone from Autel. It is worth the investment

Works great to transfer my drone and DSLR media to my iPhone or iPad. Plug and play no other software to install just open the files app and go to the drive it mounts for whatever media you are wanting to copy from . It’s pretty fast but depends on what device I’m copying to.

This adapter works great with my iPhone. I’m about to plug it in and then plug a multi card hub into it and then plug my micro SD card into that a pull / copy my drone videos to my phone. 10 times fast than copying DJI drone videos to my phone wirelessly.
Strong case used for transportation drone on a motorcycle.

I've used vertical mice before and this one is much bigger than others. That may be a good thing for some, it was a slight negative for me. I have large hands, but it's still a bit uncomfortable. Anyway, the mouse works great and I'm sure that this is a matter of preference, so I won't drone on about it. It is very responsive, took very little time to set up, and works with 2 BT computers and a third with a dongle so that's a plus!
